يصطنع (form VIII)
# يَصْطَنِعُ (yaṣṭaniʕu) /jasˤ.tˤa.ni.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# يُصْطَنَعُ (yuṣṭanaʕu) /jusˤ.tˤa.na.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# يَصْطَنِعَ (yaṣṭaniʕa) /jasˤ.tˤa.ni.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
